description:
Port enough of Claude Code's own credential storage to seamlessly pick up its OAuth token. Runs `security find-generic-password -a $USER -s 'Claude Code-credentials' -w` on macOS, parses the JSON body (top-level claudeAiOauth.accessToken), and returns the access token.

Graceful fallback:
- Non-macOS: return nil (don't error)
- `security` command unavailable: nil
- Entry not found: nil
- JSON malformed: nil

Wire into the Auth precedence chain from opi-y1y.1 (between env vars and raise).

Test with: a fake `security` binary via PATH shadowing OR by parameterizing the shell-out (easier). Cover macOS/non-macOS paths with OS detection.
title: Claude Code keychain reader (macOS)
